narrative.summary: Iran governs AI mainly through the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution, which on 29 Khordad 1403 (18 June 2024) approved the outline of a National AI Document, created a National AI Steering Council and established a National AI Organization under the President, as confirmed by the presidency's official report. An earlier draft National AI Development Roadmap was published by the ICT ministry's research institute in October 2022. Iran has no general data protection law; a personal data protection bill is pending.

instruments.current_status: Single-article resolution no. 236 (notification no. 6614) approved at the Council's 901st session on 29 Khordad 1403 (18 June 2024) and notified on 10 Tir 1403 (30 June 2024); the Council's site also lists a later resolution amending the note to this resolution (date not found). The National AI Organization's statutory basis was later set by the National AI Development Law (Majlis, approved 28 Mordad 1405 / 19 August 2026, communicated 22 Shahrivar 1405 / 13 September 2026), listed under Leads because no official text has been located.
instruments.summary: Single-article resolution of the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution that endorses the outline of the National AI Document and delegates approval of its detailed provisions to the Council's standing council (shora-ye mo'in). It creates a National AI Steering Council chaired by the President to plan, coordinate and oversee implementation, and establishes the National Artificial Intelligence Organization as an independent body under the President whose head acts as the steering council's secretary. A note tasks the Vice-Presidency for Science, Technology and Knowledge-Based Economy with drafting the organization's statute within three months for approval.

instruments.summary: Draft national roadmap for AI development prepared by the AI Innovation and Development Centre of the ICT Research Institute, with input from academia, industry and the private sector, using the methodology of the Supreme Council of Science, Research and Technology. It sets a vision, macro policies, values and strategies with actions, programmes and projects in two parts: developing AI applications in priority areas such as health, transport, agriculture, education, industry and the environment, and building enablers such as specialised human resources, infrastructure, standards, data release and legal and ethical issues.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: National sources in Iran were searched, including parliament's laws and bills, the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution, the presidency, ministries and regulators. Apart from one council resolution, located but not checked in full, and a 2022 draft AI roadmap of the ICT ministry's research institute, no qualifying material was found. Not yet verified from the official text: the National AI Development Law (approval reported for August 2026), the National AI Document, the Seventh Plan provision on AI and a data protection bill.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Method note (original): This review was carried out on 12 October 2026, but official Iranian websites could not be accessed: every government, parliament and gazette site refused the connection. The one recorded document could therefore only be located, not read, and the reported 2026 AI law and the National AI Document are listed as leads. Iran is marked for a later retry.

Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. All Iranian official hosts (sccr.ir, rc.majlis.ir, qavanin.ir, rrk.ir, isti.ir, ict.gov.ir, president.ir, ai.gov.ir) failed with curl (reset) and WebFetch (503/502). The single record (SCCR resolution 236) is located only from the search engine's indexed copy of the official page; its adoption event was dropped because the date was not read on the source. Iran is not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched for Majlis laws and bills on AI (National AI Development Law 2026, Seventh Development Plan Law Art. 65(c)) and the data protection bill; rc.majlis.ir, qavanin.ir and rrk.ir unreachable, so held as leads.; Government: Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution (resolution no. 236 recorded, located only; National AI Document held as lead), presidency and Vice-Presidency for Science and Technology (National AI Organization); sccr.ir, president.ir, isti.ir unreachable.; Ministries: Searched ICT (draft roadmap lead), health/medical ethics, education, administrative and recruitment organisation: no official AI document text located; sites unreachable.; Regulators: No data protection authority exists; searched cyber/passive defence, central bank and telecom regulator AI documents: searched, nothing found.. Not reached: All Iranian official hosts (sccr.ir, rc.majlis.ir, qavanin.ir, rrk.ir, isti.ir, ict.gov.ir, president.ir, ai.gov.ir) unreachable by curl and WebFetch; no document text could be read; Ministry-level AI documents (health, education, justice, defence, finance) not checkable on their sites; Central Bank of Iran, CRA (telecom regulator), AFTA/passive defence AI documents. Could not verify: sccr.ir/pro/3432 (resolution no. 236); National AI Document official text; National AI Development Law official text and dates; Seventh Plan Law Art. 65(c) wording; ICT ministry draft AI roadmap page. binding-law, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.

Local retry 2026-10-18 (home connection in Saudi Arabia, ~20 min): reachable: president.ir (HTTP 200; news page 152404 read; site search used), ict.gov.ir (301 then 200; news 125180 read), ai-center.ir (ITRC AI centre; draft roadmap PDF downloaded), cbi.ir (200, homepage only, not searched for AI documents in the time box), shora-gc.ir (301, not searched). Still failing: sccr.ir (curl connect timeout; headless Edge 60 s timeout), rc.majlis.ir (TLS handshake failure in curl; ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED in headless Edge), rrk.ir, isti.ir, cra.ir, parliran.ir (connect timeouts), irna.ir (reset), ai.gov.ir and isiri.gov.ir (DNS not resolved), dotic.ir (403), qavanin.ir and dolat.ir (curl gets a JavaScript redirect stub; headless Edge gets an ASP.NET runtime error page for search and law TreeText pages). Added i-656c704cf699 (draft roadmap, PDF text layer reversed so only partly read) and corroborating presidency source s-bc8183cc3252 for i-da97f9ccd5b3. Search list not completed (council, parliament, gazette, standards body, central bank and telecom regulator not searched in full), so last_deep_review left unchanged.

leads.title: قانون ملی توسعه هوش مصنوعی
leads.note: Reported as approved by the Majlis on 28 Mordad 1405 (19 August 2026), confirmed by the Guardian Council on 4 Shahrivar 1405 (26 August 2026) and communicated to the President for implementation by the Speaker on 22 Shahrivar 1405 (13 September 2026) under Article 123 of the Constitution; 12 articles and 8 notes; gives the National AI Organization a statutory basis as an independent body under the President, sets duties on compute, data access, skills, security assessment and financing, and reportedly a four-level risk classification. Dates come from discovery reports only. No official text could be located on rc.majlis.ir, qavanin.ir or rrk.ir (all unreachable). Record as binding_law once the official text (Majlis law database or Official Gazette) is read. Earlier: 'طرح ملی هوش مصنوعی' general outline approved 28 Ordibehesht 1404. Update 2026-10-18: rechecked; the Majlis research centre site (rc.majlis.ir) refused the connection, the national laws portal qavanin.ir answered only with a redirect/error page, and rrk.ir timed out; the official presidency site search found no text of the law. Still a lead.

leads.title: سند ملی هوش مصنوعی جمهوری اسلامی ایران
leads.english_title: National Artificial Intelligence Document of the Islamic Republic of Iran
leads.issuing_authority: Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution
leads.note: National AI strategy (ten-year horizon to place Iran among the top ten AI countries; application areas and enablers incl. data, standards, legal and ethical issues). Outline endorsed at SCCR session 901 (29 Khordad 1403 / 18 June 2024) with detailed provisions delegated to the standing council; reported as communicated to executive bodies in Mordad 1403 (August 2024). Official full text on sccr.ir not located (only a keyword listing page, https://sccr.ir/keywords/1/11996/, and copies on non-official sites); sccr.ir unreachable. Record as national_strategy once the official text is read. Update 2026-10-18: sccr.ir still unreachable. The official presidency report of 29 Khordad 1403 (https://president.ir/fa/152404) confirms approval of the document's outline and its ten-year top-10 goal, but the document text itself was not found on an official site. Still a lead.
